original_rule.policy: First >=3-window mixed run with an earlier >=3-window E-only run and later >=3-window P-only run. No manual T or offset.

rule.policy: Keep both-appearance criterion and original support requirements; reject candidates followed by an E-only run with at least3 centres spaced by one window width before their supporting Periderm run. No new candidate coordinates or offsets invented.
rule.assumption: Long E-only returns weigh against an early mixed burst; short E-only fields can occur within mixed tissue.
